maddeler.e:
تذوكرت (form VI)
# تُذُوكِرْتُ (tuḏūkirtu) /tu.ðuː.kir.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تُذُوكِرْتَ (tuḏūkirta) /tu.ðuː.kir.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تُذُوكِرْتِ (tuḏūkirti) /tu.ðuː.kir.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تُذُوكِرَتْ (tuḏūkirat) /tu.ðuː.ki.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
